Inglewood, California
  July 14, 2020

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
July 14, 2020, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Mayor Butts called the City Council into Closed Session at the hour of 1:00 p.m.
The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Mayor Butts, Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales
  and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.
City officials and personnel present for closed session were as follows:

  Aisha Thompson  Acting City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEM. Mayor Butts
inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City Council on the
Closed Session Item No. CS-1.

There was no response.

Mayor Butts recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:01 p.m. for Closed Session Item
No. CS-1.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, and Housing Authority at the
hour of 2:03 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary announced the
presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts/Council Members/Successor Agency
  Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla,
  Morales and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.

follows:
  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*

  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*

  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
item on the Agenda.
Wanda Brown, City Treasurer, spoke concerning the City’s Finances.

Aisha Thompson, Deputy City Clerk, read public comments from Allison Gallenger.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member/

  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated July

  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by

  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members

  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

 301  PUBLIC HEARING HELD – SELF STORAGE FACILITIES; ORDINANCE NO.
  20-11 INTRODUCED AND ADOPTED – EXTENDING INTERIM ORDINANCE
  19-15 FOR AN ADDITIONAL 180 DAYS. The next scheduled matter was a public
  hearing to consider extending the Moratorium established by Ordinance No. 19-15 up to
  an additional 180 days on any self-storage facilities in the City or upon the effective date
  of a self-storage facility ordinance, that notice had been given in the time, form and
  manner as required by law, and no communications were received.

  Artie Fields, City Manager, presented the staff report dated July 14, 2020.

  Mindy Wilcox, AICP, Planning Manager, gave a brief oral report.

  Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present that wished to address the City
  Council.

  There was no response.

  Following discussion, it was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by
  Council Member Morales that further reading be waived. The motion was carried by the
  following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  Thereupon, Ordinance No. 20-11 entitlted:

  EXTENSION OF URGENCY INTERIM ORDINANCE NO.: 19-15 FOR
  AN ADDITIONAL ONE EIGHTY DAYS OR UPON THE EFFECTIVE
  DATE OF A SELF-STORAGE FACILITY ORDINANCE,
  WHICHEVER IS FIRST, CONTINUING A MORATORIUM ON ANY
  AND ALL BUILDING PERMITS, BUSINESS LICENSES,
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMITS, OR ANY ENTITLEMENTS FOR
  ESTABLISHING OR EXPANDING ANY SELF-STORAGE FACILITY
  ANYWHERE IN THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD

  was introduced Council Member Franklin.

  Furthermore, it ws moved by Council Member Dotson, and seconded by Council
  Member Morales that Ordinance No. 20-11 entitled:

  EXTENSION OF URGENCY INTERIM ORDINANCE NO.: 19-15 FOR
  AN ADDITIONAL ONE EIGHTY DAYS OR UPON THE EFFECTIVE
  DATE OF A SELF-STORAGE FACILITY ORDINANCE,

  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin and Mayor Butts; and

 131.7  AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO AGREEMENT NO. 14-142 APPROVED – SERCO, INC.
  Staff report dated July 14, 2020, was presented recommending approval of Amendment
  No. 1 to Agreement No. 14-142 with SERCO, Inc., to modify scope of services and
  increase maximum annual compensation amount as follows: 1) For the contract year
  beginning June 1, 2020 to May 31, 2021, increase the maximum annual compensation
